title: Greetings and introductions
canDo: I can greet someone, say my name and where I am from, and ask the same in return.

pattern.name: ser + presentations
pattern.explanationEn: Use 'ser' to say who you are and where you are from: 'soy' (I am), 'eres' (you are, informal), 'es' (he/she/it is). In Mexico, 'tú' is the default with people your age; 'usted' is for elders and formal settings.

examples.es: Soy Ana y soy de Guadalajara.
examples.en: I'm Ana and I'm from Guadalajara.

targetWords.example: Hasta luego, que te vaya bien.

modelSentences.es: Hola, me llamo Gautam. Mucho gusto.
modelSentences.en: Hi, my name is Gautam. Nice to meet you.

modelSentences.es: Soy de Estados Unidos, ¿y tú de dónde eres?
modelSentences.en: I'm from the United States, and where are you from?

modelSentences.es: Hasta luego, que te vaya bien.

scenarioHint: You arrive at a friend's house party in Colonia Roma, Mexico City, and meet someone new at the door.
